title: Scientists discover a surprising danger in smaller cancer cells
caption:
It turns out size matters when it comes to cancer cells. Researchers discovered that unusually small tetraploid cells are far more aggressive than their larger counterparts, growing faster and resisting treatment. This finding could help us better understand and predict how tumors behave.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a surprising danger in smaller cancer cells
